name: european_open_momentum_continuation
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When London opens at 13:30 IST, European institutional desks begin routing directional orders into NIFTY's largest ADR/GDR-linked constituents — HDFC Bank, RELIANCE, ICICI Bank, INFOSYS, and TCS collectively represent ~38% of NIFTY's weight. Simultaneous institutional buying or selling of these five heavyweights creates a measurable directional impulse on the NIFTY index that persists for 30-120 seconds as domestic market makers delta-hedge and momentum algorithms pile in behind the initial European order flow. We enter in the direction of this impulse at 13:30 IST when the 30-minute pre-European-open momentum and session VWAP alignment both confirm the directional bias, capturing the first burst before the effect dissipates as US pre-market liquidity competes for attention from 14:30 IST onward.

indicators.name: mom_360
indicators.purpose: 30-minute momentum heading into European open. Lookback is 360 bars × 5s = 30 minutes — the SAME 30-minute window as the original (momentum_30 at 1-min bars). This is a FIXED TIME WINDOW context filter: we want to know which direction the 30 minutes before 13:30 were drifting, because European participants look at the same pre-open trend to decide their initial order direction. 12x scaling happens to be correct here because we are measuring the same 30-minute context, not compressing it.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP from 09:20 IST open. No scaling needed — cumulative measure. NIFTY above VWAP at 13:30 IST signals that institutional accumulation dominated the morning session; European participants entering in the same direction as the morning's institutional bias creates a self-reinforcing flow rather than fighting an established trend.

indicators.name: mom_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute burst momentum (24 bars × 5s). NEW indicator not present in original — at 1-min bars the original could not distinguish the first 2 minutes of European open acceleration from a broader drift. At 5s resolution, mom_24 detects whether NIFTY has already started moving in the direction of the 30-min trend at the European open, confirming that institutional orders are actively working rather than pending. Lookback of 24 bars = 2 minutes is the minimum window to see a meaningful acceleration at 5s resolution.

buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

buy_pe.confirmation: All three conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points: if NIFTY fails to extend within the first 30-60 seconds of European open, the institutional order flow has likely been absorbed by liquidity providers without triggering momentum continuation — the thesis is wrong and we cut quickly. At 5s bars, a 30-second (6-bar) stall followed by 4-point adverse move on ATM option is the clear signal that European flow is absent or was already priced in.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points = ~12 NIFTY spot points: the first 60-90 seconds of European open continuation on a 0.3%+ pre-trend momentum day typically pushes NIFTY 10-20 spot points in the entry direction. 6 pts captures ~50-75% of the expected first-leg move (conservative, because we are trading at limit prices and want consistent wins over large targets). At 1:1.5 R:R, a 55% win rate is profitable at this cost structure.

filters.vix_filter: none — European open flow is present regardless of VIX regime
filters.time_filter: 13:30-14:15 IST only (European open window; effect dissipates as US pre-market opens at 14:30 IST)
filters.trend_filter: 30-min momentum confirms pre-European direction; 2-min burst confirms active flow

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — structural, tied to permanent ADR/GDR cross-listing of Indian large-caps in global markets

adaptation_notes: Original was a cross-stock equity strategy trading 5 ADR-linked NIFTY constituents individually at 1-min bars, holding 45-90 minutes, entering EXACTLY at 13:31. Conversion to NIFTY index options required three key changes: (1) COLLAPSED from 5 individual stocks to the NIFTY index — feasible because the 5 ADR stocks constitute ~38% of NIFTY weight, and their simultaneous directional flows produce a measurable index-level impulse; (2) COMPRESSED hold time from 45-90 minutes to 15-120 seconds — we capture the first burst of the European open effect rather than riding the full continuation, requiring tighter stops/targets calibrated to 1-minute NIFTY move magnitudes; (3) ADDED 2-min burst momentum (mom_24) as a trade trigger — at 1-min bars the original could not isolate the initial 2-minute acceleration; at 5s bars this distinction is critical to avoid stale entries. The 30-minute context momentum lookback (360 bars) is preserved at the same calendar time (30 min) because this is a FIXED TIME WINDOW: we are measuring the same pre-European-open directional bias.
weaknesses: European and UK bank holidays reduce signal frequency significantly
UK/India daylight saving time shifts change the European open from 13:30 to 14:00 IST seasonally — strategy must adjust time filter accordingly
Macro risk events (RBI, Fed) announced near 13:30 can override European open flow
On low-participation days (thin European summer) the flow impact on NIFTY may be insufficient to clear 6 option points
